node.statement: Extended approximate C-star package: writing P=tilde-Phi, d=||P-Phi||_cb at most r and M=1+r, the inherited matrix norms, involution and unit and the product X star Y=P(XY) make every M_n tensor Im(P) an epsilon_AI-algebra with exact unit and involution, submultiplicativity error r, associativity error at most 20eta+2(M^5-1), and C-star lower-norm error at most 3r-r^2; for sufficiently small universal eta their maximum epsilon_AI is less than 1, is O(eta), and all constants are independent of n and dim(H).
